problem_choice.justification: Issuer authorization performance is bounded by the twin tension between Fraud Losses and False-Positive Declines. In our portfolio, legacy static rules ('59 Suspected Fraud' and '05 Do Not Honor') falsely decline thousands of legitimate E-Commerce and high-ticket transactions while still letting ~45% of true fraud slip through into post-auth chargebacks. Predicting fraud probability accurately allows the issuer to simultaneously auto-approve low-risk transactions (lifting overall approval rate and recovering lost interchange) while blocking high-risk fraud before settlement.

validation_split.strategy: Strict Chronological / Out-of-Time Split (Zero Future Leakage)

test_oot.period: 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-31 (26 Days, incl. Oct Cyber Sale)
